title: Red Modpack
description: This is a modpack to play Blood On The Clocktower with proximity chat and some additional features.
body:
**This is a client modpack to play Blood On The Clocktower in Minecraft!**
> [Blood On The Clocktower](https://bloodontheclocktower.com/) is a social deduction game developped by The Pandemonium Institute.

This modpack has a proximity chat and add others pretty fun and usefull features to play a social deduction game.

This modpack include:
- Proximity chat
- REPO talking head (how to [setup eyes](https://modrinth.com/mod/repo-heads))
- Custom Discord Status
- Iris with some Shaders (you can [add your own](https://modrinth.com/discover/shaders))
- Emoticons (you can [add your own](https://emotes.kosmx.dev/))

This modpack is designed to be played in a Red Clocktower hosted game.

You can use this modpack for your own game as well! You can even use it to play any social deduction game.
You just need to add server side [simple voice chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat) and [emotecraft](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emotecraft) plugin/mod, and have an appropriated map.

_Red Clocktower is not affilitated with the Pandemonium Institute_
